text: This report provides an overview of Metrolinx’s construction plans for the Ontario Line Lower Don Bridge and the slope stabilization works at the Minton Place Portal, located within the Don Valley Crossing area. These works will involve temporary closures of the Don Valley Parkway, F.G. Gardiner Expressway, and Don Roadway at various stages between 2025 and 2027. The report outlines key construction activities, associated staging plans, and temporary lane closures required to safely and efficiently deliver these infrastructure works. While most temporary lane closures occur during overnight hours to minimize impacts, one full weekend closure of the Don Valley Parkway is required to facilitate the launch of the new bridge structure.
